_comment: ReImagined loading-screen tips (launcher/forza_launcher/loading_tips.py). One entry per tip: its title (at most 19 characters) and its text (plain, at most 194). Each of the game's tip slots gets one entry in turn; every language shows them in English for now.

tips.title: SHARE YOUR SHOTS
tips.tip: Got a shot worth framing? Snap it in Photo Mode and send it to forza.dyotson.dev. The whole Festival is watching, so make it count.

tips.title: TUNE YOUR RIDE
tips.tip: That stock setup won't cut it forever. Get into the garage and tune your ride with the native tuning menu: gearing, grip, launch. Make it yours.

tips.title: HD TEXTURE PACKS
tips.tip: Colorado has never looked this sharp. Drop in an HD texture pack (Mods > Texture packs) and see every mountain like it's the first time.

tips.title: FM4 LEGENDS
tips.tip: Forza Motorsport 4 legends are crashing the Festival. Import FM4's cars from your own disc and send them flying down the Rockies.

tips.title: YOUR SOUNDTRACK
tips.tip: Your road trip, your soundtrack. Load your own songs onto the radio, give your station its own logo, and drive to your own beat (Mods > Radio).

tips.title: FAST TRAVEL
tips.tip: Why drive across the map when you can just be there? Fast Travel Anywhere is unlocked for everyone. Pick a spot and go.

tips.title: CAR SOUNDS
tips.tip: Want that turbo to scream? Turn it all the way up in Settings > Audio > Car sounds. Or mute the engine and just listen to the road.

tips.title: FORZA LIVE
tips.tip: New challenges drop every day and every week on Forza Live. Beat them, climb the boards, and grab the weekly gift.

tips.title: DRIVE TOGETHER
tips.tip: The Festival is better with friends. Start a co-op Festival from the map, talk in club chat, and share your best cars with the club.

tips.title: BENCHMARK
tips.tip: Frames dropping? Hit BENCHMARK on the main menu, let it race for you, and see exactly what your machine can push.

tips.title: JOIN THE FESTIVAL
tips.tip: Drivers from all over, one Festival. Find your crew on the Discord at forza.dyotson.dev.

tips.title: REWIND
tips.tip: Rewind, retry, redeem. No one has to see that corner. Just make the next lap legendary.
